# An exact larger complete-record error for the coherent-memory example

Author: `producer-workspace/recovery_challenge`. This is an additional authored result produced during independent challenge. It is not silently included in the review of root's pinned theorem, and its independent review is separate.

Use exactly the two-arrival operation in Section 5 of `MEMORY_FAULT_INTERFACE.md`: source bits x,z, environment branch

    V_xz=(X^x Z^z) tensor (X^x Z^z),

the complete Bell receiver, its prescribed source phase feedback, and coherent storage fault

    E=cI-isQ, Q=Z tensor I, c=4/5, s=3/5.

Write c=cos(theta), s=sin(theta), so 0<theta<pi/4. Root's input |+> on source x and common environment |00> gives distance 3/5, as stated there. That input-specific value is not the universal complete-record norm.

## Exact actual common-receiver reduction

Each V_xz is a Hermitian involution, and its Bell eigenvalue lambda_y(x,z) is the feedback phase. Consequently

    lambda_y(x,z) <Bell_y| E V_xz
      = <Bell_y| V_xz E V_xz
      = <Bell_y| exp[-i theta (-1)^x Q].

The corrected actual channel is therefore the common Bell-measurement channel after

    U_actual=exp[-i theta Z_x tensor Q].

The common noisy-receiver baseline is that same Bell channel after

    U_base=exp[-i theta I_source tensor Q].

These identities concern the actual Bell records and do not discard an outcome or introduce a new source control. They hold on arbitrary source/environment/reference inputs.

The relative unitary U_base* U_actual has spectrum contained in

    {1, exp(2i theta), exp(-2i theta)}.

For every normalized state, including purifications, the real part of its expectation of this relative unitary is at least cos(2theta)>0. The trace distance of the two pure unitary outputs is therefore at most sin(2theta). Convexity and the common Bell channel give the complete-instrument half-diamond upper bound

    epsilon_complete <= sin(2theta)=2cs=24/25.

## A purely record-based matching witness

Prepare the allowed source basis input x=1,z=0 and the common environment state

    |psi>=(|Phi+>+i|Phi->)/sqrt(2)
          =[(1+i)|00>+(1-i)|11>]/2.

Only the Phi records occur. The common noisy receiver gives

    P_base(Phi+)=(c+s)^2/2=49/50,
    P_base(Phi-)=(c-s)^2/2=1/50.

The corrected actual receiver gives the probabilities in the opposite order. Their total variation distance is 2

# Exact source-only norm for the coherent-memory example

Author `/root`. This follow-up is separate from the pinned memory-fault theorem; its independent review is recorded with the coherent-memory extension.

Use the Bell-eraser model in `reviews/memory_faults/COHERENT_RECORD_EXTENSION.md`, with E=exp(-i theta Q), Q=Z_1, c=4/5 and s=3/5. After Bell feedback the actual instrument is the common Bell receiver following exp(-i theta Z_x tensor Q); its baseline follows exp(-i theta I tensor Q). Trace every receiver output and record. The resulting maps take the joint source/environment input to the source. No field-independent source channel is assumed.

Write a joint density operator in source-x blocks rho_ab, with source z and arbitrary references included inside each block. Diagonal output blocks equal the baseline. The off-diagonal difference is

\[
A=\operatorname{Tr}_E[(e^{-2i\theta Q}-I)\rho_{01}].
\]

Trace-norm duality, including any reference extension, gives

\[
\|A\|_1\leq\|e^{-2i\theta Q}-I\|\|\rho_{01}\|_1
\leq2\sin\theta\sqrt{\operatorname{Tr}\rho_{00}\operatorname{Tr}\rho_{11}}
\leq\sin\theta.
\]

The dual operator is a tensor product of a reference contraction and the field operator, so arbitrary references do not change this bound. The source difference has Hermitian blocks [[0,A],[A*,0]], whose half trace norm is ||A||_1. This proves the universal source-only upper bound sin(theta) for arbitrary initial correlations.

A Q eigenstate and source x in |+> give the source rotation diag(e^-i theta,e^i theta), saturating the bound. Thus the exact universal source-only half-diamond distance from the receiver-traced common-input baseline is 3/5. It is the norm of a map on the joint input, not one source channel for all field states.

The separately proved complete-record distance in the same model is 24/25. These are exact norms for different output interfaces. The false classical Pauli replacement predicts 9/25. Additional acquired corrective controls could change these prescribed-protocol performances.

statement: For the declared two-arrival Bell receiver and coherent storage E=(4I-3iZ)/5, the source proves universal source-only half-diamond3/5 and complete actual-record half-diamond24/25 on arbitrary joint source/environment/reference inputs. A matching record-only witness swaps1/50 and49/50 while leaving the source unchanged. Replacing this fault by a classical Pauli mixture predicts9/25 and is invalid.
